text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити's summer camp begins. Serious
and
dedicated to her training, she cuts
off all contact
with everyone back home.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She's eager to better herself for the
upcoming
Kikuka Sho. Her heart seems
ablaze with
motivation.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
